loop.top3_series_pattern: moderate seasonal, noisy, ambiguous trend, few outliers, ranking moderate
loop.top3_why: The mean strategy (full pool) shows consistent performance across all three validation windows (all ≈0.60) and aligns with the diagnostic hint of a selective combination but with high variance in weight estimation. Its stability outweighs the single‑window advantage of the best‑single rf strategy, which has a highly erratic per‑window profile (0.505, 0.927, 0.267). The mean also matches the dataset‑wide trend where median/trimmed‑mean strategies outperform mean, suggesting that a simple average is a robust baseline for this series.
loop.top3_why_not: Candidate B, while having the lowest mean validation score, suffers from extreme per‑window volatility and a very high error in the second window, indicating over‑fitting to a single window. Candidate C, though close in score, also shows a large spread across windows and relies on externally trained weights that may not generalize well to this series’ noisy regime. Therefore, the plain mean offers the most reliable generalization for the blind test window.
